verdict.rationale: OCI has no documented dedicated sandbox or test mode. The closest evidence is a separate Free Trial or Always Free account that can serve as an isolated non-production environment, plus IAM policies that govern access to resources, so isolation from production comes from account setup rather than a built-in sandbox. Community reports say idle Always Free compute is reclaimed after 7 days of low utilization, which limits its use as a standing test environment. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment feature, documented separation of test and production data (e.g., per-environment compartments or data cloning), and independent corroboration of sandbox workflows.
